recent_tweets.text:
exploring ways to spin up agents from my phone

iOS shortcuts × github actions × cursor cli

world_signals: ledger engines tuned to nanosecond precision
ruby actors spinning up a new web server generation
vision models flashing faster than thought
summer fog settling over san francisco at fourteen degrees
late august dusk, sun still an hour from setting

composer-2.5-fast.concept: Steer a cable car through Karl the Fog — swipe between lanes as landmark silhouettes flicker in and out of visibility.
composer-2.5-fast.session_hook: each run reveals one new SF landmark before the fog swallows it again
composer-2.5-fast.escalation: fog thickens, lanes narrow, ghost cars drift into your path
composer-2.5-fast.aesthetic: muted watercolor hills and cable car lines

gpt-5.5-extra-high.concept: Tap to commit transactions into a nanosecond ledger — miss the beat and the whole chain reverts.
gpt-5.5-extra-high.session_hook: a perfect streak triggers a satisfying cascade of confirmed blocks
gpt-5.5-extra-high.escalation: block time shrinks, competing validators flood the mempool
gpt-5.5-extra-high.aesthetic: neon wireframe terminal green on black

claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.concept: Vision flash cards appear for half a second — trace the path you saw before the image dissolves.
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.session_hook: each round adds one more flash to memorize in sequence
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.escalation: flash duration drops, shapes overlap, static noise creeps in
claude-opus-4-8-thinking-max-fast.aesthetic: polaroid flash photography with heavy grain

gemini-3.1-pro.concept: Flick parallel agent dots from your phone into task orbits before they idle out and vanish.
gemini-3.1-pro.session_hook: chaining three agents into one orbit triggers a merge burst
gemini-3.1-pro.escalation: more idle agents spawn, orbits shrink, gravity wells pull them off course
gemini-3.1-pro.aesthetic: paper cutout iOS shortcut icons on a desk surface
